name: mc_insufficient_failsafe_min_history_boundary
description: AC-2 boundary case. MC history at EXACTLY MC_MIN_HISTORY_DAYS days must run the real Monte Carlo path and return a genuine probability (NOT the insufficient sentinel). One day fewer must return the insufficient sentinel. This pins the inclusive/exclusive boundary of the sufficiency guard so the fix does not move it.
provenance: Schema-derived synthetic history; day counts taken from math_engine.MC_MIN_HISTORY_DAYS at test time, not hardcoded.

contract.at_min_history: num_days == MC_MIN_HISTORY_DAYS -> run_monte_carlo returns a real probability: a finite float in [0, 100], NOT the insufficient sentinel.
contract.below_min_history: num_days == MC_MIN_HISTORY_DAYS - 1 -> run_monte_carlo returns the distinct insufficient sentinel.

derivation: The day count is read from math_engine.MC_MIN_HISTORY_DAYS in the test. No producer probability is pinned -- the at-boundary case asserts only shape/range and 'is not the sentinel'; the below-boundary case asserts 'is the sentinel'.
